limitations: Dense finite numeric arrays only; sparse inputs and non-Euclidean metrics are outside this atom batch.
Tree algorithm, leaf_size, tolerance, and breadth-first options are validated for source API compatibility but scoring uses exact dense pairwise kernel sums.
Sampling is exposed only for gaussian and tophat kernels, matching sklearn sample support.
Compact kernels may produce negative infinity log densities for zero-density queries; atoms guarantee non-NaN shaped outputs rather than finite scores for those cases.
